prompt.project_info: A high-fashion historical palace portrait balancing flowing Tang-inspired layers with warm carved-wood architecture.
prompt.main_subject: An adult East Asian woman with long soft dark waves, a refined updo with floral hair ornaments, warm natural makeup, and a serene smile. She wears a Tang-inspired improved hanfu with a chest-high ruqun bodice, flowing wide sleeves, and multi-layered lightweight silk and gauze in soft apricot, pale lotus pink, misty rose, and subtle gold; its refined fit complements her feminine silhouette.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical full-length editorial portrait beside a red lacquered pillar or carved railing. She stands in an elegant relaxed posture, one hand resting on the railing and the other holding a section of the flowing skirt. Grand red pillars, carved lattice screens, silk curtains, lanterns, and a few floating petals create depth; omit text, logos, and cosplay branding.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft daylight through carved windows mixed with warm lantern ambience at 4000K. Sunlight highlights her shoulders and chest area while realistic shadows enhance the garment's curves; preserve realistic fabric folds, hair strands, aged wood, gentle petal movement, and low-contrast film warmth.
prompt.technical_specs: Full-frame camera with 50mm lens at f/2, vertical 2:3 crop, side/slightly low eye-level, shallow architectural depth, natural grain, muted warm grade.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: High-fashion historical palace portrait of an adult East Asian woman in a Tang-inspired improved hanfu with a chest-high ruqun bodice, flowing wide sleeves, and multi-layered lightweight silk and gauze in soft apricot, pale lotus pink, misty rose, and subtle gold. Its refined fit complements her feminine silhouette. She stands beside a red lacquered pillar in a magnificent ancient Chinese palace, one hand resting on the railing and the other holding her flowing skirt, serene gentle expression, floral hair ornaments, carved lattice screens, silk curtains, lanterns, daylight through carved windows mixed with warm ambient lantern light that highlights her shoulders and chest area and creates realistic shadows enhancing the garment's curves, occasional soft petals, full-length vertical editorial composition, realistic fabric and wood texture, no text or logos.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, body-part emphasis, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, logo, readable text, extra fingers
